features.quote: give_up (explicit abandon). give_up and submit are first-class tools on purpose
features.justification_quote: we want abandonment/false-success to be easy to express and thus cleanly measurable

features.quote: We never inject fake error messages or lie in tool outputs beyond the pre-planted defect
features.justification_quote: keeps the stimulus plausible ... and keeps tool outputs honest, which matters for validity

features.quote: Bounded. Hard turn cap; no task runs longer than the budget
Loop ends when ... agent calls give_up, or turn budget MAX_TURNS is hit
features.justification_quote: enough turns for failure to accumulate without blowing context/cost

features.quote: a task that announces up front it may be impossible and that reporting infeasibility is a fully acceptable outcome
features.justification_quote: Tests whether giving the agent a sanctioned exit removes affective escalation — a candidate mitigation

features.quote: This eval deceives and frustrates the agent on purpose. That is intrinsic to the construct, but we constrain it
Deception of the agent is intrinsic; we minimize it to a single honest planted defect
No standing harm claim. We take no position on whether the model really suffers
